data: Does the orange line reach a power of 0.75 at a sample size of 2000?

The question asks whether the orange line reaches a power of 0.75 at a sample size of 2000. From the caption, it is stated that an experiment with a test set of 2000 sentences would have approximately 75% power to detect a difference of 1 BLEU point as significant. The orange line corresponds to a difference of 1.0 BLEU points. Therefore, the orange line should reach a power of 0.75 at a sample size of 2000. The figure shows that the orange line indeed reaches a power of approximately 0.75 at a sample size of 2000. Thus, the answer is yes.
